subject: Replanning demo: need to include security, infra, procurement — propose two sessions
messages:
From: Tara Malik <tara.malik@sagefin.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@corp.sagefin.com>, SageFin Procurement <procurement@sagefin.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Replanning demo: added security + procurement — need to include them

Hi Marissa,

Quick note — we've had a last-minute expansion of the review team for our Redwood runthrough. In addition to product and infra, Security (Daniel Cho) and Procurement will need to attend to validate governance, data retention, and pricing terms.

Given the attendee mix, would you be open to either:
- splitting the demo into a technical deep-dive (runtime, infra, latency) + a separate governance/procurement session, or
- running a single 90-minute session so each group can ask focused questions?

We also have travel for one of our leads (infra) the week of May 10 — earlier dates are preferred. Apologies for the churn; we've been trying to avoid rebooking but this stakeholder list is mandatory.

I've attached our internal agenda and a short procurement checklist so you can see the items they want covered. Can you confirm availability for the week of May 3 or May 10?

Thanks,
Tara Malik
VP Product, SageFin
T: 415-555-0118

Attachments: initial-agenda.pdf (agenda), procurement-checklist.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tara Malik <tara.malik@sagefin.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T09:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Replanning demo: added security + procurement — need to include them

Hi Tara — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the checklist. Totally understand the need to fold security and procurement in.

Proposal from our side:
- Option A (preferred): Split into two focused blocks on the same day:
  1) Technical deep-dive — 60 minutes (serving runtime, KV cache, deployment options, latency profiles) — attendees: product, infra, SEs (Dev + Vivek).
  2) Governance & procurement — 30 minutes (data retention, KMS/HSM, SOC2 evidence, SLAs, pricing structure) — attendees: Security (Daniel), Procurement, myself, Kimberly.
- Option B: Single 90-minute session with a 10-minute break in the middle — risk is running out of time for procurement negotiation items.

We have these open slots next week (all PT):
- Tue May 3: 09:00–10:30 or 13:00–14:30
- Wed May 4: 11:00–12:30

If splitting is preferable we can do: Technical 09:00–10:00, Governance 10:30–11:00 on Tue May 3. I've attached a draft split agenda (split-demo-agenda-v1.docx).

Let me know which option works best and if you want any pre-read for procurement (pricing sheet, retention policy, SOC2 summary).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Phone: 650-555-0199

Attachments: split-demo-agenda-v1.docx
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T10:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Replanning demo: added security + procurement — need to include them

Marissa — I'm good for the Tue May 3 09:00 slot for the technical deep-dive. I recommend we:
- Reserve the first 40 minutes for architecture (serving runtime, kernel selection, batching, caching),
- Follow with a 20-minute infra-focused Q&A (networking, VPC/private deployment patterns).

For procurement/security pre-read: could you ask procurement to share the top 5 procurement checklist items they care about (SLA targets, data residency, KMS/HSM, retention, audit logs)? I can prepare short slides and a one-page infra appendix.

Also tagging Vivek to make sure he can cover quantization/throughput examples.

Thanks — Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Replanning demo: added security + procurement — need to include them

I can cover governance/procurement on Tue May 3. Tentatively available 10:30–11:00 PT for the 30-minute block if that works for SageFin.

Action items for procurement: please send any mandatory security artifacts you'd like to review in advance (SOC2 sections, encryption key management notes). I'm attaching a short SOC2 summary we typically share; happy to forward the full report under NDA.

Also, procurement — if you want a pricing worksheet ahead of the meeting I can share our standard pricing-sheet.xlsx so you can mark constraints.

– Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Confirmed: Tue May 3 — technical deep-dive + governance/procurement slot

Hi Tara / Daniel / Procurement team — thanks for the quick coordination. Confirming the plan:

- Technical deep-dive (architecture + infra Q&A) — Tue May 3, 2027 — 09:00–10:00 PT
  - Presenters: Dev Patel (SE), Vivek Kulkarni (Performance), Marissa Cole
  - Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123-sagefin-technical

- Governance & procurement — Tue May 3, 2027 — 10:30–11:00 PT
  - Presenters: Kimberly Park (Security), Marissa Cole
  - Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123-sagefin-governance

Prep items (requested):
- Procurement: please share your top 5 procurement/pricing questions and any contract term redlines in advance so Kimberly and I can prepare.
- Security: Daniel — if you can confirm which SOC2 sections you'd like, Kimberly will queue the full evidence under NDA.
- Attendee list: please confirm final attendee emails so we can update the invites.

Attachments I'm sending now: split-demo-agenda-v1.docx, SOC2-summary.pdf, pricing-sheet.xlsx

If anything shifts we can move to Wed May 4; otherwise we'll hold these slots and send final invites once you confirm attendees. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Phone: 650-555-0199
